index.subtitulo: Automation panel to configure, optimize and customize your Fedora Linux quickly and safely.
index.card_guiado_desc: Follow the Fedora configuration sessions step by step, in the right order — the order matters for the end result, so this is the only way to go through them.
index.card_manut_desc: Everyday tasks that don't depend on order: manage kernels, clean temporary files, adjust GRUB, update or uninstall FOF.
index.sobre_texto: FOF is an open-source tool that automates the main Fedora Linux setup tasks, from installing codecs and repositories to optimizing the system and managing kernels.
index.dica1: Progress of each action saved automatically on the local server
index.dica5: Commands validated and tested for Fedora
index.dica6: Support for GNOME, KDE, XFCE and more
index.footer_creditos: Fedora Only Fans — Made with ❤️ by VitãoTub
index.footer_legal: Fedora is a registered trademark of Red Hat, Inc. This project is not affiliated with Red Hat.

00-boas-vindas.descricao: Before proceeding with the configuration and app installation steps, a complete update of your operating system is highly recommended.
00-boas-vindas.atualizacao_desc: Updates the repository index, synchronizes security keys and downloads the latest versions of all system components.

01-restauracao.btrfs_desc: Btrfs-Assistant is a graphical tool to manage snapshots of the Btrfs filesystem, allowing you to create and restore backups of your system.
01-restauracao.info_extra: ℹ️ Btrfs-Assistant lets you create snapshots before making changes to the system, ensuring you can restore if something goes wrong.

02-otimizacao.dnf_desc: Configures simultaneous parallel downloads and enables automatic lookup of the fastest server mirror.
02-otimizacao.dnf_info_extra: ℹ️ The setting will be applied with the selected value. You can reapply with different values at any time.
02-otimizacao.idioma_desc: Install translation packages, spell checker, and change the system default locale:
02-otimizacao.idioma_aviso: ⚠️ Note: Restart your computer after completing step 3 to apply the language changes!
02-otimizacao.dual_boot_desc: Configures the hardware clock to use UTC standard, avoiding time confusion when switching systems.

03-repositorios.rpm_titulo: Enable RPM Fusion Repositories (Free and Non-Free)
03-repositorios.rpm_desc: Installs and synchronizes the official RPM Fusion repositories, adds AppStream metadata support and runs a security adjustment.
03-repositorios.flatpak_desc: Adds the global Flathub repository and ensures the Flatpak package manager is installed on the system.
03-repositorios.codecs_desc: Replaces ffmpeg-free with the full unrestricted version, installs essential gstreamer plugins and enables Cisco OpenH264.
03-repositorios.extras_desc: Enables restricted sub-repositories to enable commercial DVD playback and proprietary firmware.
03-repositorios.confirmar_reverter_extras: Remove the extras and DVD support?
03-repositorios.vaapi_titulo: VA-API and Codecs for Graphics Acceleration
03-repositorios.vaapi_desc: Installs hardware video acceleration drivers and utilities for AMD and Intel graphics cards.

04-fontes.fontes_desc: Installs the Microsoft fonts installer from SourceForge to get Arial, Times, Calibri, etc.
04-fontes.fontes_aviso: ⚠️ This process downloads and installs proprietary Microsoft fonts. Make sure you comply with the licensing terms.
04-fontes.info_extra: ℹ️ Fonts installed: Arial, Times New Roman, Calibri, Cambria, Candara, Consolas, Constantia, Corbel, and others.

05-launchers.vulkan_desc: Installs Vulkan tools and libraries in 32 and 64-bit versions for native Proton support.
05-launchers.launchers_desc: Install the main game launchers and essential packages for Fedora.
05-launchers.launchers_info: ℹ️ All launchers are installed via Flatpak.
05-launchers.compat_desc: Tools to run Windows games and programs outside of Steam, and features that help performance while gaming.
05-launchers.compat_info_extra: ℹ️ Winetricks installs extra components (fonts, libraries) inside a Wine prefix. Bottles is a modern alternative to plain Wine, with visual management of "bottles" (prefixes) and Proton-GE runner support. GameMode sets CPU/GPU to maximum priority while a game is running. MangoHud shows an FPS/CPU/GPU overlay inside the game.

06-loja.obs_titulo: 🎬 OBS Studio - Installation and Virtual Camera
06-loja.obs_desc: Install OBS Studio for recording/streaming and enable the virtual camera for video calls.
06-loja.obs_aviso: ⚠️ The virtual camera requires Secure Boot to be configured correctly or disabled.
06-loja.easyeffects_desc: Sound effects processor for PipeWire to apply noise reduction and equalization.
06-loja.edicao_desc: Complete tools to edit what you record or produce: cuts, transitions and track mixing.
06-loja.affinity_desc: Affinity has no native Linux version. This button opens the AffinityOnLinux installer, a community project (not affiliated with Serif/Canva) that sets up a pre-configured Wine environment to run Affinity.
06-loja.affinity_aviso: ⚠️ You must have purchased and downloaded the Affinity .exe installer from the official Serif/Canva website before using this — FOF only prepares the Wine environment and opens the community installer; that installer will ask for the .exe file at the right moment. It's a third-party project: if something doesn't work on your hardware, check their known issues page.
06-loja.affinity_prereq: 📦 Prerequisite: PyQt6 is required for the installer interface. FOF checks and installs it automatically if needed.

07-manutencao.limpeza_desc: Cleans the DNF cache, orphaned dependencies and unused Flatpak runtimes.
07-manutencao.kernel_desc: Manage the kernels installed on your system.
07-manutencao.kernel_aviso: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Removing an older kernel version is not recommended because Fedora keeps only the last 3 kernels.
07-manutencao.kernel_msg_atual_nao_removivel:
❌ Cannot remove the kernel you are currently using ({kernel}).

Reboot with another kernel before removing this one.
07-manutencao.kernel_confirmar_remocao:
⚠️ WARNING!

You are about to remove the kernel:
{kernel}

Are you sure you want to continue?
07-manutencao.grub_desc: Configure GRUB to always show when the computer turns on and set the display time to 10 seconds.
07-manutencao.grub_aviso: ⚠️ This change affects system boot. Make sure GRUB is installed correctly.
07-manutencao.grub_confirmar_recomendado:
⚠️ Apply the recommended GRUB configuration?

• GRUB will always show on boot
• Display time: 10 seconds
07-manutencao.grub_confirmar_padrao: Restore default GRUB configuration (timeout=5 seconds, hidden)?
07-manutencao.grub_msg_correto:
✅ Configuration correct!
GRUB_TIMEOUT=10 (10 seconds)
GRUB_HIDDEN_TIMEOUT not set (GRUB always shows)
07-manutencao.grub_msg_incorreto:
⚠️ Current configuration:
GRUB_TIMEOUT={timeout} (expected: 10)
GRUB_HIDDEN_TIMEOUT={hidden} (expected: not set)
Click "Apply Recommended Configuration" to fix.

08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_desc: Downloads and installs the latest version of FOF directly from GitHub. Keep your app always up to date!
08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_info: ℹ️ Updating keeps your settings and history.
08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_confirmar:
🔄 Update Fedora Only Fans to the latest version?

This will download and install the latest version from GitHub.
08-fof-manutencao.desinstalar_desc: Completely removes FOF from your system, including all files, settings and shortcuts.
08-fof-manutencao.desinstalar_aviso: ⚠️ WARNING: This action is irreversible! All FOF data will be removed.
